about: Made-up job postings for generation's extraction (title, requirements, level) and topic draft, run through the service's own nodes; plus reviewer instructions for the topic revision on drafts from inputs.json. Postings: company and product names a template must drop, lists of interchangeable and different items, an instruction hidden in a posting, a German posting for an English test, an English posting for a Japanese test, a senior scope, and tests in Arabic, Thai, Hindi and Russian (one per script family). Each lists what must be covered (`must_cover`) and what must not appear (`forbidden`, `forbidden_in_template`); each revision what a right result does. Checked by code and judged by judges/extraction.md, judges/topics.md and judges/revision.md. Hand-written.

postings.kind: edge: company and product names, for a template
postings.text:
Customer Success Manager at Brightloom

Brightloom makes LoomDesk, the help desk used by 2,000 online shops. Join our Lisbon team!

What you'll do
- Onboard new LoomDesk customers and run their training calls
- Track account health in our in-house tool PulseBoard and act on churn signals
- Renew and expand contracts with your accounts

What you bring
- 3+ years in customer success or account management for software products
- A CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce or similar
- Clear written English; Portuguese is a plus

We offer a yearly team trip and free lunches.
